baseline_models.focus_anchor: بَيْنَهُمَا, بَرْزَخٌ, and the dual negation لَا يَبْغِيَانِ
baseline_models.mechanism: An occupied middle differentiates two agents, while the dual negated verb makes restraint reciprocal: neither side converts meeting into overreach.

activation_trace.role: The interval or middle supplies a positive zone between the two, not merely a line of exclusion.
Overstepping into oppression supplies the prohibited conversion of proximity into domination.

changed_reading.before: A barrier simply keeps two entities apart.
changed_reading.after: The barzakh is an ordered interval in which two meeting agents remain distinct through mutual non-encroachment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The relational pronoun in بَيْنَهُمَا together with the two active subjects of يَبْغِيَانِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The in-between can name the tie joining parties as well as their separation; the barrier therefore functions as a joint that permits relation while arresting each side's pursuit of total possession.

activation_trace.role: The branch's standing connection between parties makes the middle a relation-bearing joint.
Seeking and pursuit supply the outward drive that the relational joint regulates rather than erases.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes isolation by obstruction.
changed_reading.after: The verse describes connection without absorption: a relation is sustained because each party's pursuit stops short of consuming the other.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ب ي ن construction at بَيْنَهُمَا and the modal pressure of لَا يَبْغِيَانِ
baseline_models.mechanism: Branches of ب ي ن turn distinction into visibility and disclosure; paired with the form-distant possibility branch of ب غ ي, the boundary can be carried as a readable sign that makes crossing unavailable or unfitting.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and becoming clear make the interface perceptible as a distinction.
Disclosure by expression or sign lets the boundary communicate the ordering it enforces.
What is fitting or possible supplies an exploratory modal shade to the negation: crossing is not made available to the pair.

changed_reading.before: The restraint is an unseen physical blockage.
changed_reading.after: The restraint may also be informational: a manifest interface tells each side where its fitting range ends.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier teaching of البيان activates the disclosure branch in the later locative بَيْنَهُمَا, strengthening the possibility that the boundary both separates and explains the distinction.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of meaning by expression or sign supplies the surah's earlier model of an intelligible distinction.
Becoming visible anchors that disclosed distinction in the focus ayah's in-between.

structural_cues: 55:4 places taught البيان before the spatial بَيْنَهُمَا of 55:20.
The same root moves from communicative disclosure to a locative relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the root recurrence and disclosure branch; I infer that taught distinction becomes spatially enacted at 55:20; a live alternative is simple polysemy with no cross-ayah transfer.

changed_reading.before: The barzakh is only a mute separator.
changed_reading.after: The barzakh is also an articulated interface: its separation makes the two domains intelligible as two.

context_deltas.mechanism: The balance sequence supplies alignment between two sides and explicitly opposes limit-exceeding, recasting the barzakh as an active regulator of coupled forces rather than inert matter.

activation_trace.role: Balancing and aligning two things supplies the regulatory geometry later enacted between the pair.
Overflowing water or sweeping force literalizes limit-exceeding as a dynamic pressure, not only a moral fault.
The standing connection between parties lets the regulator couple the sides it balances.
Transgressive overstep names the imbalance the regulator prevents.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 sets a balance, forbids exceeding it, and commands just measure before the sea pair appears.
Both passages coordinate two-sided relations through a negative limit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies alignment, overflow, and overstep images; I infer a common feedback principle from measure to waters; the alternative is a thematic analogy rather than one causal system.

changed_reading.before: A fixed wall passively blocks motion.
changed_reading.after: The barzakh behaves like dynamic balance: it continuously permits coupled motion while correcting any drift toward one side's domination.

context_deltas.mechanism: Release, wide waters, and the convergence of opposed things place the barrier after motion into contact; its work is therefore performed inside an encounter, where it contains disorder without cancelling meeting.

activation_trace.role: Release into open ranging supplies the initial freedom of motion.
Mixture and disorder supply the unstable outcome that release could produce.
Abundant wide water supplies the material field in which the encounter unfolds.
Two opposed things converging establishes real contact before the focus ayah names restraint.
The interval becomes a contact zone occupying the meeting's middle.
Overstepping identifies the disordered capture excluded within that zone.

structural_cues: 55:19 immediately supplies the antecedent pair and says they meet.
The sequence is release, encounter, interposed barzakh, then dual non-transgression.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies release, possible mixture, and convergence; I infer that the barzakh governs contact after it begins; the alternative is that meeting means only approaching a hard divider.

changed_reading.before: The barrier prevents the two seas from ever contacting.
changed_reading.after: The barrier is a contact-zone law: the seas meet and remain mobile, but encounter does not become disorderly annexation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The refrain immediately classifies the sea-boundary episode among favors, while lordly repair and completion supply a teleology: restraint preserves rather than merely denies.

activation_trace.role: Favors and benefits frame the just-described boundary as a positive provision.
Repair, nurture, and completion supply the preserving purpose assigned to the restraint.
Prevented domination becomes the concrete benefit rather than a bare prohibition.

structural_cues: The recurring favor-denial refrain follows 55:20 directly at 55:21.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies immediate evaluative framing and a nurturing lordship branch; I infer that preserved difference is the favor; the alternative is that the refrain scopes the whole maritime unit without isolating the boundary.

changed_reading.before: The boundary is a neutral constraint.
changed_reading.after: The boundary is itself a gift: each side is protected from the other's excess, allowing both to continue as themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: What follows comes out from the paired domain, so non-transgression does not imply sterility; the differentiated interface permits emergence and valuable yield.

activation_trace.role: Passage to the outside supplies real output from the two-water system.
The coral branch places a valuable product on the spectrum between pearl and bead, embodying differentiated yield.
The connection between parties lets the boundary function as a productive relation rather than a seal.
Regulated seeking supplies exchange or draw without unrestricted seizure.

structural_cues: 55:22 follows the boundary refrain and attributes emergence to the dual source with مِنْهُمَا.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies output from the pair and a relational middle; I infer selective productivity across or at the interface; the alternative is collective dual attribution that says nothing about permeability.

changed_reading.before: A barrier's success is measured by stopping all transfer.
changed_reading.after: The barzakh is selectively productive: it preserves identities while allowing the paired system to yield what neither isolated side signifies alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The rapid move from universal passing-away to divine remaining temporalizes the focus order: the barzakh can be a maintained created condition rather than an eternal binary built into reality.

activation_trace.role: Cessation after continuance places every created arrangement under an endpoint.
Continuance and remaining provide the contrast that distinguishes maintained order from the one who remains.
The branch's time during an ongoing state supplies a deliberately form-distant temporal possibility for the in-between.
Fitting or becoming possible makes non-crossing contingent on an enabled order rather than sheer incapacity.

structural_cues: 55:26-27 follows the maritime unit with a sharp created/transcendent duration contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ending, remaining, and a temporal branch of ب ي ن; I infer that the boundary's efficacy has a maintained duration; the alternative is that the temporal contrast does not qualify the earlier barzakh.

changed_reading.before: The verse asserts an absolute and timeless partition.
changed_reading.after: The verse may describe a sustained created regime: while it is maintained, neither side can make overreach its fitting course.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later penetration language distinguishes an impassable-looking boundary from a passage conditioned by authority, activating a jurisdictional reading of the focus prohibition.

activation_trace.role: Clean passage through to the other side supplies the exact motion tested at a cosmic perimeter.
Compelling warrant or proof supplies the condition under which passage differs from transgression.
The interval becomes a threshold with jurisdictional depth.
Oppressive overstep distinguishes unauthorized incursion from passage as such.

structural_cues: 55:33 addresses the same dual audience and repeats negated penetration before making an exception for سلطان.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies blocked traversal plus an authority condition; I infer a permissioned-threshold analogy for 55:20; the alternative is that سلطان concerns creaturely cosmic escape only, not the waters' relation.

changed_reading.before: No crossing occurs because a material wall makes it impossible.
changed_reading.after: The barzakh can be read as jurisdiction: what is excluded is unauthorized overreach, not the abstract possibility of passage or relation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later splitting and becoming of the sky supplies a reversal test: stable cosmic interfaces can change state, so present non-transgression need not be ontological incapacity.

activation_trace.role: Rending and opening supply a reversal in which a seemingly enclosing cosmic surface ceases to hold its prior form.
Occurrence and presence in time make the transformed state an event rather than a timeless essence.
Separation after connection supplies the focus order that the later rupture makes conceptually reversible.
Possibility or fittingness carries the exploratory claim that non-crossing belongs to a current regime.

structural_cues: 55:37 converts the raised sky of 55:7 into a split and transformed surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a later cosmic interface changing state; I infer that the focus boundary is actively maintained and therefore conceptually reversible; the alternative is that the sky event has no bearing on the sea boundary.

changed_reading.before: The two cannot transgress because their difference is metaphysically frozen.
changed_reading.after: Their non-transgression may be the present achievement of an ordered regime, one whose interfaces can be altered when the cosmic state changes.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later construction with the same locative root hosts repeated motion between two poles, activating the possibility that an in-between is a constrained route or circuit rather than empty distance.

activation_trace.role: Circling around supplies repeated, bounded movement through a relation.
The interval between two poles functions as the corridor occupied by that circulation.
The focus interval can therefore be spatially thick enough to host constrained motion.
Pursuit supplies motion whose range is bounded without being eliminated.

structural_cues: 55:44 repeats بَيْنَ twice inside a verb of circulation between two named poles.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit moving-between construction; I infer that 55:20's middle may be an occupied corridor; the alternative is that the later punitive circuit should not spatially specify barzakh.

changed_reading.before: The middle is a vacant gap or solid wall.
changed_reading.after: The middle can be a regulated corridor: motion occurs within the relation, but cannot escape its assigned circuit into annexation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later paired gardens, paired flowing springs, and paired kinds turn duality into a generative architecture; differentiation is what lets abundance recur in paired forms.

activation_trace.role: A source of running water supplies a renewed dual-water image inside paired gardens.
Flow and spreading keep the paired sources dynamic rather than sealed.
A mate joined to its counterpart makes pairing a relation that preserves two-ness.
Connection between parties anchors the repeated pairs as coordinated rather than isolated.
Bounded pursuit becomes the motion by which paired systems interact without losing differentiation.

structural_cues: Dual morphology proliferates after 55:20: two gardens, two springs, and paired kinds.
The later springs flow, so paired distinction coexists with movement and fecundity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated productive pairs and flowing sources; I infer that 55:20 seeds a paired-ecology grammar in which boundaries enable abundance; the alternative is rhetorical duality without mechanistic dependence on the sea boundary.

changed_reading.before: Two-ness is a conflict requiring containment.
changed_reading.after: Two-ness is productive design: the barzakh preserves differentiated partners so flow, pairing, and yield can multiply rather than collapse into sameness.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later reciprocal formula for beautiful action activates a social-ethical analogue: the focus boundary is a relation in which each party's restraint makes answerable reciprocity possible.

activation_trace.role: Answering an act with its recompense supplies the structure of reciprocal response.
Beautiful action repeated on both sides supplies the positive content of reciprocity.
The tie between parties anchors the ethical transfer in a real relation.
Mutual non-overreach supplies the negative condition that keeps response from becoming domination.

structural_cues: 55:60 balances two occurrences of الإحسان around a question of recompense.
55:20 likewise predicates one negated action of both members of a pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reciprocal syntax and a branch of inter-party connection; I infer an ethical analogue from ecological restraint to mutual answerability; the live alternative is a cross-domain echo with no intended social rule.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports only a physical regularity.
changed_reading.after: The physical regularity can model an ethic: durable relation requires both parties to answer without crossing into coercive possession.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because both activated corruption senses are remote from the local forms: الأرض at 55:10 is not a sore and يَبْغِيَانِ is not explicitly a wound. It remains anchored in the packet's focus ب غ ي branch and the barzakh interval, with a second packet branch independently picturing sore-corruption. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy for containment, not a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The negated ب غ ي verb and the barzakh occupying بَيْنَهُمَا

activation_trace.role: A wound spreading into corruption supplies a concrete model of harmful propagation across a margin.
Corruption of a sore with matter independently reinforces the pathological-spread image within the packet.
The middle interval functions analogically as healthy tissue or a containment margin.

changed_reading.before: Non-transgression means only moral restraint or blocked movement.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the barzakh is a healing margin that prevents contact from becoming wound-like propagation into the other body.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus ب غ ي rain branch is rare and the later gushing springs do not name the sea barrier. It remains materially anchored in the focus's dual non-baghy and wide-gap branches, while context explicitly supplies flooding force and abundant water. Render it as a hydraulic systems analogy, not as a claim that بَرْزَخ lexically means spillway.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The wide in-between and the dual negation of ب غ ي

activation_trace.role: Rain exceeding need supplies the hydraulic failure mode prevented by non-baghy.
Overflowing water and sweeping force supply pressure that can exceed a limit.
Water welling up abundantly supplies sustained input rather than static pools.
Distance and a wide gap give the regulator storage or dissipation depth.

changed_reading.before: The barzakh is a solid dam whose ideal state is no flow.
changed_reading.after: The barzakh can be imagined as a spillway or pressure regulator: it receives motion and abundance while preventing either body from becoming an excessive downpour into the other.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the final تَبَارَكَ uses the blessing sense, while the stable-water basin is a different branch of the same context root. It remains worth carrying because that root closes the surah with both basin and stable-growing-good branches, which jointly reactivate the focus's relational waters. Downstream prose should present this as retrospective branch resonance, never as the direct meaning of تَبَارَكَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The barzakh within the relation بَيْنَهُمَا and the regulated seeking of the pair

activation_trace.role: Water held stable in a basin supplies a closing material analogue for bounded waters.
Stable, growing good supplies the value produced by that holding rather than mere immobilization.
The connection between parties makes bounded stability a property of the paired relation.
Regulated pursuit lets the stable relation remain active and generative.

changed_reading.after: In a contained retrospective resonance, it is basin-like blessing: holding waters in relation converts restraint into stable, growing good.

strongest_changes: The wall reading became an active contact-zone regulator because release and meeting precede non-transgression.
The interface became selectively productive and permission-sensitive rather than absolutely impermeable.
Repeated balance, favor, pairing, and reciprocity made preserved difference a generative good, not a defect awaiting merger.
Later rupture and duration cues kept the present order maintained and potentially reversible rather than metaphysically frozen.
summary.what_was_special: The most activating feature was reversal inside the branch inventory: ب ي ن could connect and disclose as well as separate, while ب غ ي could name pursuit, modal availability, oppressive overreach, pathological spread, or excess water. Context then turned one short prohibition into coexisting hydraulic, relational, jurisdictional, informational, temporal, ecological, and ethical mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet gives no focus branch inventory for بَرْزَخ itself, so its internal material image remains underdetermined.
It is uncertain whether مِنْهُمَا at 55:22 entails contribution from each side or attributes emergence collectively to the pair.
The disclosure, temporal, wound, rain, and basin activations are branch-distant and should remain possibilities rather than replacements for the locative and transgression senses.
The late penetration, circulation, paired-garden, and reciprocity passages may retroactively specify 55:20, or may only provide analogies that the reader has connected.
